    Diamond: generators and deep vanishing #

    DiamondData.Gen D: ρ = ω' α generates the radical of End y and σ = γ η that of End x (self-dual). With it, the morphisms of P_x and I_y beyond τ vanish by power counting:

    • τρ_zero: τ ≫ ρ = 0 (from ω' ≫ η ∈ (τ)), στ_zero: σ ≫ τ = 0 (dual);
    • rad_τ: u ≫ τ = 0 for u in the radical of End x, τ_rad: τ ≫ v = 0 for v in the radical of End y.
